Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim purposes. Can you confirm
you're comfortable continuing?
A: Yes, that's fine.
Q: Let's start with what happened. Can you walk me thruogh the collision in your own words?
A: I was making a left turn at an intersection in Baytown, Texas. The light had turned yellow when I started into the
turn, and a vehicle coming from the opposite direction struck the front driver's side of my car.
Q: Where were you coming from and where were you headed?
A: I was heading home from work. I was going to turn onto the side street on the left.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you started the turn?
A: I saw headlights, but it looked far enough away that I thought I had time. I misjudged it.
Q: Were there any witnesses, or did you take any photos at the scene?
A: A man in a truck stopped and gave me his number. I took a few pictures of both cars and the intersection with my
phone.
Q: How are you feeling physically right now?
A: My right shoulder hurts quite a bit. It's worst when I lift my arm above my head or reach behind me. I was sore the
next morning and I went to urgent care that afternoon.
Q: Have you received any treatment since then?
A: I've been referred for physical therapy and I'm scheduled to start next week. I'm also taking an anti-inflammatory.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add before we finish?
A: Only that I'm trying to get back to work as soon as I can, so I'd appreciate a quick response on the vehicle repair.
Q: Thank you. We'll follow up with you in writing about next steps.
A: Thanks, I appreciate it.
</page>

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
